n6d4fe63013.headline: One in every three electric cars sold is Chinese-made, Korea's market changes dramatically
n6d4fe63013.summary: More than one-third of electric vehicles sold in South Korea in the first half were made in China. Chinese-made EVs also overtook Germany in the imported car market for the first time.
n6d4fe63013.why: South Korea is a major car market and home to large domestic automakers, so shifts in import share affect competition in the EV segment.

n2350d55ed2.summary: Wistron's Q2 net profit rose 54% quarter on quarter to about NT$14.8 billion, with EPS of NT$4.72, a single-quarter record. First-half EPS was NT$7.78.
n2350d55ed2.why: Wistron is a Taiwan-based contract manufacturer of servers and electronics, so its results signal demand for AI infrastructure hardware.

nf38c38caa5.summary: Prices in Italian restaurants and hotels rose noticeably more than inflation would suggest, according to the report. Italy is also a leading holiday destination for Poles this year.
nf38c38caa5.why: Services inflation in hospitality feeds into consumer price trends and tourism revenues that matter for Italian growth and related equities.

n2b90e75350.headline: The World Bank Just Put a Number on Morocco's Jobs Crisis... And It's Bigger Than Most People Realize.
n2b90e75350.summary: The World Bank estimates Morocco faces an annual jobs crisis equivalent to a city the size of Meknes becoming unemployed every year.
n2b90e75350.why: High unemployment impacts economic growth, social stability, and investment climate in Morocco.

n996a44775e.headline: Guanajuato Silver Company Ltd.: Guanajuato Silver Receives Drilling Permits for El Horcon Project
n996a44775e.summary: Guanajuato Silver Company announced formal approval from the Mexican government for drilling permits at its El Horcon project.
n996a44775e.why: Obtaining drilling permits is a key step for mining companies to advance exploration and development, potentially increasing resource valuation and investor interest.
